statement:
theorem anonymous_reads_by_profile_only (ident : Identity) (u : IdentUser)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved) (e : Entry)
    (attrs : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (hu : ident.origin = .User u) (ha : u.entry.uuid = UUID_ANONYMOUS)
    (hs : ¬ HasClass u.entry "sync_object")
    (h : search_acc.apply_search_access ident related e = ok (.Allow attrs)) (hx : x ∈ attrs.val) :
    ∃ acs ∈ related.val, x ∈ acs.attrs.val := by
  sorry

def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

spec.name: classes
spec.code:
/-- The entry's classes: its `class` attribute when it is a case-insensitive
string set, else none. -/
def classes (e : Entry) : List (List Nat) :=
  match ava e (lit "class") with
  | some (.Iutf8 s) => names s.val
  | _ => []

def search_acc.apply_search_access
  (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved)
  (entry : Entry) :
  Result search_acc.SearchResult
  := do
  let asr ← search_acc.search_filter_entry ident related_acp entry
  let (denied, grant, allow) ←
    match asr with
    | AccessSrchResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessSrchResult.Grant =>
      ok (false, true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessSrchResult.Ignore =>
      ok (false, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessSrchResult.Allow attr =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
      let allow1 ← bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      ok (false, false, allow1)
  let asr1 ← search_acc.search_oauth2_filter_entry ident entry
  let (denied1, grant1, allow1) ←
    match asr1 with
    | AccessSrchResult.Deny => ok (true, grant, allow)
    | AccessSrchResult.Grant => ok (denied, true, allow)
    | AccessSrchResult.Ignore => ok (denied, grant, allow)
    | AccessSrchResult.Allow attr =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
      let allow2 ← bset.extend allow s
      ok (denied, grant, allow2)
  let asr2 ← search_acc.search_applications_filter_entry ident entry
  let (denied2, grant2, allow2) ←
    match asr2 with
    | AccessSrchResult.Deny => ok (true, grant1, allow1)
    | AccessSrchResult.Grant => ok (denied1, true, allow1)
    | AccessSrchResult.Ignore => ok (denied1, grant1, allow1)
    | AccessSrchResult.Allow attr =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
      let allow3 ← bset.extend allow1 s
      ok (denied1, grant1, allow3)
  let asr3 ← search_acc.search_sync_account_filter_entry ident entry
  let (denied3, grant3, allow3) ←
    match asr3 with
    | AccessSrchResult.Deny => ok (true, grant2, allow2)
    | AccessSrchResult.Grant => ok (denied2, true, allow2)
    | AccessSrchResult.Ignore => ok (denied2, grant2, allow2)
    | AccessSrchResult.Allow attr =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
      let allow4 ← bset.extend allow2 s
      ok (denied2, grant2, allow4)
  if denied3
  then ok search_acc.SearchResult.Deny
  else
    if grant3
    then ok search_acc.SearchResult.Grant
    else
      let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
      if i != 0#usize
      then
        let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow3
        let allowed_attrs ← bset.intersection s s1
        ok (search_acc.SearchResult.Allow allowed_attrs)
      else ok (search_acc.SearchResult.Allow allow3)
